programme.title: Ancient Worlds
programme.sub-title: City of Man, City of God
programme.desc: Richard Miles explores the rise and fall of the Roman empire, which at the height of its power, extended the benefits of its civilisation to a staggering 60 million subjects and citizens, from Hadrian's Wall to the banks of the Euphrates. The archaeologist and historian also learns how the expansion of Christianity filled a gap left by the Roman multi-god belief system, eventually leading to the instalment of Constantine as the first Christian emperor

programme.title: The Latest Secrets of Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the latest research into the creation of the ancient Egyptians' written language. The programme follows Egyptologists as they unlock the texts inscribed inside a richly adorned tomb, revealing the beliefs and lives of the priests, scribes, painters, engravers and builders who created this grand funerary monument

programme.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands
programme.desc: New Zealand is now home to some of the richest agricultural land in the world, boasting magnificent gardens with plants from around the planet and rare magical creatures. A caving expedition reveals relics of the original lost world of its pre-human past; the actual bones of a cow-sized flightless grazing bird, a moa, among the largest birds that has ever lived. However, as narrator Sam Neill reveals, against all the odds, one giant bird from primeval New Zealand has survived to this day

programme.title: Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: Ben Garrod explores how skin has evolved to enable animals to move in a range of habitats, revealing how adaptations allow birds to fly, sharks to speed through water and sugar gliders to take to the air

programme.title: Gareth Edwards' Great Welsh Adventure
programme.desc: Gareth and his wife Maureen Edwards head to St Davids, a place which holds half a lifetime of special memories for them. They visit a shire horse farm and find out who can master driving a shire horse-drawn carriage. Plus, The pair take a trip to a remote bird sanctuary and discover the colony of razorbills

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Audrey relishes her role as county commissioner for the Girl Guides when she reprimands Richard for not sponsoring a fundraising event in aid of a new scout hut. Comedy, starring Penelope Keith and Peter Bowles

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth disappoints Richard by buying him a pair of skis for his birthday, intending to strap them to the car in yet another attempt to impress the neighbours. However, the scheme backfires when her rich sister Violet arrives and cuts her down to size

programme.title: The Normans
programme.desc: Professor Robert Bartlett examines the impact of the conquest of Britain and Ireland, and learns how William the Conqueror built scores of castles and cathedrals to impose his control and intimidate the population. The ruler also commissioned the Domesday Book to survey the wealth of the land and raise revenue, and set in motion the linguistic and cultural transformation of England. The Normans blended well in Scotland, but faced fierce opposition in Wales, and promoted divisions in Ireland which some claim still exist to this day

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: The story of Kwame Brathwaite, the Harlem photographer, activist and cultural pioneer whose work helped define the iconic Black Is Beautiful movement. Across a career spanning more than seven decades, Kwame captured over 500,000 images documenting African American life, creativity and identity, while championing Black pride through photography, fashion and grassroots activism

programme.title: Light and Dark
programme.desc: Part two of two. Professor Jim Al-Khalili visits the Gran Sasso National Laboratory in Italy, where scientists are attempting to capture and study dark matter. He also reveals how the discovery that the expansion of the universe is accelerating has led to theories that a mysterious new force called dark energy is in the process of gradually tearing the universe apart

programme.title: Gareth Edwards' Great Welsh Adventure
programme.desc: In the Brecon Beacons, Gareth and wife Maureen inspect their accommodation - a shepherd's hut complete with lush rolling hills for a view and sheep for neighbours. Out and about, they receive a lesson in controlling a full-sized tank, with Maureen keen to see how the vehicle can pick up speed. After getting some tips from champion clay pigeon shooter Rhys Lewis, photographer Rhian Mai meets the pair at a spectacular natural cave to help hone their skills in capturing the scene. The weekend ends where the original adventure began - on one of Wales' most beautiful canals

programme.title: How the Romans Conquered the Alps
programme.desc: Exploring Emperor Augustus's Alpine campaign, revealing the route, weapons and tactics used by the Romans to successfully annex the unconquered Alps. A team of archaeologists, forensic and ballistics experts reconstruct the campaign. The findings reveal how Roman soldiers coped in the harsh mountain conditions during the conquest

programme.title: Building Sights
programme.desc: Architect Sand Helsel applauds Trellick Tower, a brutalist tower block in west London, designed by Erno Goldfinger and completed in 1972. First broadcast February 5, 1991

programme.title: The Planets
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox examines Jupiter, the largest and oldest planet in the solar system, revealing how its immense gravity influenced where other planets developed, destroying several nascent planets and negatively influencing the development of Mars. Today, Jupiter's great mass continues to be felt. Its gravity torments its moon Io, creating the most volcanically active body in the solar system. And through the vice-like grip it exerts over the asteroid belt, Jupiter's influence extends as far as Earth

programme.title: The Singing Detective
programme.desc: In the detective story playing out in Marlow's head, his fictional private eye pursues the two mysterious men - but back in the real world, the author receives a shock when he spots the same two men on the ward. He then has another session with Dr Gibbon, in which he recalls a disturbing incident with his mother. Meanwhile, Nicola and Mark continue their fraudulent plan

programme.title: The Singing Detective
programme.desc: Michael Gambon stars in the conclusion of Dennis Potter's surreal 1986 drama. Dr Gibbon coaxes Philip into revealing more about his childhood traumas, leading his various fictions and memories to intertwine. The characters become angry, and seek retribution on their creator, while the sinister figure of the scarecrow stalks the wards

programme.title: Timewatch
programme.desc: An investigation into the Gunpowder Plot of 1605. The programme focuses on how a group of Catholic Englishmen became so radicalised and intent on mass murder they attempted to destroy the Houses of Parliament. State-of-the-art CGI shows the building as it would have looked, and the extent of the damage if the explosion had taken place

programme.title: Edwardian Farm
programme.desc: To mark the half-way point of their sociological experiment, Alex Langlands, Peter Ginn and Ruth Goodman explore a single day in an Edwardian farmer's household. Using a cache of letters from the time found in Morwhellham to research the realities of life, the trio experience typical daily routines, from the usual early morning hair-styling and oral hygiene, to the end-of-the-day trip to the local pub

programme.title: Edwardian Farm
programme.desc: Spring sees the daffodil harvest, accompanied by a rush to get the flowers off to the train station so they can be delivered to towns and cities across the country within hours of being picked. Alex Langlands and Peter Ginn go to Dartmoor for the annual pony trek, and use the occasion to purchase one of the beasts for the farm. However, before their new pony is fit for work, he needs to be trained, and the farmers hire American horse whisperer Mike Branch for the job. Meanwhile, the arrival of new lambs is followed by a pleasant surprise for Ruth Goodman in the run-up to Mother's Day

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Road Trip

programme.title: Case Sensitive
programme.desc: Part one of two. New DS Charlie Zailer finds herself working with DC Simon Waterhouse for the first time when Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, and the two argue about whether the case is one of murder, suicide or something more sinister. Meanwhile, a woman tells her best friend she had an affair with Bretherick's husband and wants to see him again. Thriller, based on the novel Point of Rescue by Sophie Hannah, starring Olivia Williams, Darren Boyd, Rupert Graves and Amy Beth Hayes

programme.title: Attenborough's Wonder of Song
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines seven recordings of animals singing, all documented in his lifetime - including one he recorded himself. The songs are from species as varied as lyrebirds, lemurs and humpback whales, all providing an insight into the way these creatures communicate. The programme also examines new evidence on the purpose of singing, which challenges the long-held belief that it is a mating ritual - it has been theorised that both male and female songbirds sing as part of a survival strategy

programme.desc: Nick Knowles comes to the aid of Liz and Jason Liversidge, a Hull couple in desperate need of help in future-proofing their family home. programme.title: Shetland
programme.desc: Calder and Tosh must work together to find the armed killers and prevent further disaster, but can't agree on whether it's the work of experienced criminals, with Tosh thinking that the hand of organised crime is involved. On the other side of the island, Agnes Moffat's morning drive is interrupted by a gun-toting Howell standing in the middle of the road

programme.title: The Bay
programme.desc: DS Jenn Townsend, Morecambe's new Family Liaison Officer, is immediately thrown into the deep end when a body washes up in the bay on her first day on the job. She must get under the skin of a grieving and complicated family if she has any chance of solving the case, as well as navigating her blended family, who are struggling to settle in their new environment

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: A witchcraft scare sweeps through Aidensfield, but Greengrass, who clearly subscribes to the old adage that where there's muck there's money, is too preoccupied with a new get-rich-quick scheme to care _ he is convinced the hidden properties of local mud are about to make him a fortune. Bill Maynard stars as the rascally rustic

programme.title: Endeavour
programme.desc: Morse's investigation into a number of untimely death notices in the Oxford Mail, each with a cryptic message, takes him to a series of funerals before forcing him to confront his own mortality. Thursday is facing more than one confrontation of his own as his past closes in on him, while he resorts to desperate measures to protect those he loves most. Final episode of the Inspector Morse prequel, starring Shaun Evans and Roger Allam

programme.title: Morse and the Last Endeavour
programme.desc: Documentary marking the end of the line for the Oxford detective, exploring the huge global appeal of the original Inspector Morse series and its spin-offs, Lewis and Endeavour. Featuring interviews with all the main cast members, as well as a behind-the-scenes look at the filming of the final series of Endeavour as it ties together more than six decades of interconnecting plots

programme.title: Mountain Vets
programme.desc: Rosalind must give champion Rhodesian Ridgeback Luna an emergency caesarean to save her puppies, while USPCA head vet Gillian performs a complicated amputation on a bearded dragon's tail

programme.title: My Unique B&B
programme.desc: Simon Parfett and his team head to Somerset to work with Vicki and Bryan, who dream of spending less time at work and more time with their young family by turning a corner of their field into a unique B&B. They have a space-age geodome, but have no idea how to transform it into a welcoming rental. Simon and his team are full of ideas, including a large wooden statement bed and set of bunks, plus a botanical theme to bring warmth and colour to the large space. It's a big and physically challenging job, but with help from friends and family the team hopes to pull off an extraordinary transformation

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: A suitcase inexplicably disappears from the wreck of a crashed car - and it is not long before parcels of cash start being delivered to the residents of Aidensfield. As the mystery unravels the police investigations lead to Bernie, who may hold the key to identifying the village's very own Robin Hood. Jason Durr stars

programme.title: Upstairs, Downstairs
programme.desc: Elizabeth and James Bellamy discover former housemaid Sarah has fallen on hard times and decide to reinstate her in the household, but it isn't long before their charitable gesture backfires in unexpected fashion. Gordon Jackson, Jean Marsh, Simon Williams and Pauline Collins star

programme.title: Paddington Station 24/7
programme.desc: Behind-the-scenes look at one of the UK's busiest transport hubs, chronicling the issues that face station staff, transport workers, emergency services, commuters and tourists

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Kim is frantic, while Chas makes an accusation and Sadie manipulates the situation

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Debbie falls victim to a trick that leaves Adam's romantic idea in tatters, Ryan deduces Bethany's pregnancy, Fiz reluctantly accepts Ross's olive branch, and Brian is perplexed by a mysterious delivery

programme.title: The Royal
programme.desc: Ormerod faces a taxing time when a prison van overturns on the moors. The driver is killed, a guard is seriously injured and one of the convicts escapes, while the others are rounded up and taken for treatment at the hospital, where Ken Hopkirk recognises an old friend. Goodwin fails to diagnose a serious case of post-natal depression - an error which almost ends in tragedy when the mother is found standing perilously close to a cliff edge - and student nurse Samantha Beaumont discovers she has an unexpected love rival. Penultimate episode in the rural medical drama series, starring Robert Daws and Paul Fox

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Marple
programme.desc: Feature-length mystery, starring Geraldine McEwan as the genteel sleuth. A woman experiences an unsettling vision after moving into the home of her dreams - and it transpires she lived in the house as a child. Miss Marple investigates the history of the property and discovers it was connected with a baffling disappearance years before - which has never been solved. With Dawn French, Russ Abbot, Geraldine Chaplin, Phil Davis and Sarah Parish

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: As Christmas comes to Aidensfield, the locals have their very own Scrooge to contend with in the shape of mean-spirited bank manager Gordon Stringer. With farmer Jack Dugdale at his mercy and Greengrass on the prowl for money he is owed, his son Noel becomes fed up of taking the flak for his father's unpopularity and runs away. Drama, starring Jason Durr, Bill Maynard, Mark Jordon and Tricia Penrose

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: The detective's former colleague, Sergeant Stuart Macken, is left badly burned when his house is petrol-bombed, while his teenage daughter fights for her life in intensive care. As Vera tries to discover why anyone would attempt to kill Stuart, her investigation leads to unpleasant revelations about his personal life, and she has to face long-buried memories of her own. Crime drama, starring Brenda Blethyn, with Steven Hartley and Julie Graham

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: As the Rovers' Hallowe'en party gets underway, Fiz orders Tyrone to apologise to Chesney, Adam asks Alya to marry him, and the combination of a prison riot and a power cut leaves Sally feeling spooked

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Kim makes a dangerous move, while Liam is confused and Caleb and Ruby blame each other

programme.title: Shetland
programme.desc: Calder decides to stay on in Shetland and Tosh welcomes the support after uncovering a tattoo that sends the case in a sinister new direction. Tom Knox is identified as the main suspect in the case but a confession about his relationship with Ellen send the team back to square one

programme.title: The Bay
programme.desc: An obstreperous suspect causes difficulties for the team, until Jenn identifies a key witness who is able to unlock the answers they need. Meanwhile for Manning, juggling work and his complicated family situation proves challenging. Later, a frustrating turn in the case causes tensions to rise within the community, leading to an unexpected altercation

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: A baby is kidnapped from outside the post office, causing emotions to run high in Aidensfield. Greengrass agrees to concrete a drive to earn extra cash, but makes the mistake of hiring a helper who proves less than adept. Rural drama, starring Bill Maynard, Derek Fowlds, Jason Durr and Kazia Pelka

programme.title: Inspector Morse
programme.desc: First-ever episode of the popular crime drama, starring John Thaw as author Colin Dexter's Oxford detective who treats his cases as intellectual challenges. In this mystery, Morse is introduced to trusty Sergeant Lewis (Kevin Whately) and takes it upon himself to investigate the apparent suicide of a lady friend. Co-starring Gemma Jones, Patrick Troughton, James Grout and Peter Woodthorpe

programme.title: Posh Pawn
programme.desc: An insight into the world of high-end pawnbroking, going behind the scenes at a Surrey-based firm dealing in luxurious and exclusive objects. James Constantinou and his company, Prestige, is the place to go for the upper class wanting fast cash and it's an empire on the move

programme.title: Mountain Vets
programme.desc: On-call vets Rosalind and Aidan tackle the weekend shift in the busy spring calving season. USPCA wildlife officer Phil responds to a couple of sick swans that need rescuing, and just when Rosalind is hoping her weekend shift is drawing to a close, she gets called back to her cousin Mervyn's for the second difficult calving of the day

programme.title: My Unique B&B
programme.desc: Simon Parfett and his team head to the Black Mountains in south-east Wales to help Alex and Laura finish building a tiny house on wheels

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: As Christmas comes to Aidensfield, the locals have their very own Scrooge to contend with in the shape of mean-spirited bank manager Gordon Stringer. With farmer Jack Dugdale at his mercy and Greengrass on the prowl for money he is owed, his son Noel becomes fed up of taking the flak for his father's unpopularity and runs away. Drama, starring Jason Durr, Bill Maynard, Mark Jordon and Tricia Penrose

programme.title: Upstairs, Downstairs
programme.desc: Sarah falls for the manservant of Capt Ryttsen, a dashing Swedish army officer who is staying in the Bellamy household as a guest of James, but later finds herself suspected of betraying her employers' trust by stealing from them. Vintage drama, starring Pauline Collins and Simon Williams

programme.title: Paddington Station 24/7
programme.desc: Behind-the-scenes activities at one of the UK's busiest transport hubs, chronicling the typical and not-so-typical issues that face station staff, transport workers, emergency services, commuters, tourists and everyone in between

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Graham receives instructions from the kidnapper, while Caleb is furious and Sadie plays the innocent

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Ross's goading results in a violent outburst from Tyrone, Sally puts her foot down with Lucy, Ryan takes care of a grateful Bethany, and Debbie gives Adam a ring

programme.title: The Royal
programme.desc: Ormerod faces a testing time when his father-in-law arrives demanding to know whether he was seeing Dr Weatherill while his late daughter was still alive. Following a heated exchange, it emerges that the disgruntled patriarch has hired a private detective to investigate the couple - but the situation only serves to bring them closer together, culminating in a marriage proposal. At the Royal, a painfully thin girl causes concern for Goodwin - whose green-eyed monster emerges when student nurse Samantha Beaumont agrees to a date with a younger man - and the hospital is evacuated after a suicide victim's corpse is brought in emitting toxic fumes. Medical drama, starring Robert Daws, Amy Robbins, Paul Fox and Anna Madeley

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Marple
programme.desc: The sleuthing spinster teams up with a dashing man to investigate a series of poison-pen letters in the sleepy village of Lymstock. Two of the missives have led to the deaths of Mona Symmington, the wife of Lymstock solicitor Richard, and Agnes Woddell, the parlour maid at the Symmingtons' house. However, Miss Marple suspects there is more to these deaths than meets the eye. Murder mystery with an all-star cast, featuring Geraldine McEwan, James D'Arcy, Emilia Fox, Imogen Stubbs, Ken Russell, Harry Enfield and Kelly Brook

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: Maggie's suspicions are aroused by the death of a close friend's mother, so she goes straight to the police to report her fears, leading to a cruel dilemma. The district nurse's emotional day comes to an end when she announces her decision to leave Aidensfield, prompting the locals to throw a farewell party. Meanwhile, jealousy rears its ugly head when one of Blaketon's old flames comes back on the scene and starts taking an interest in Lord Ashfordly. Rural drama, starring Kazia Pelka, Derek Fowlds and Janie Dee

programme.title: The Hack
programme.desc: As the hacking scandal builds momentum, Nick meets with Dave's new ally Gordon Brown, who persuades him that there is still work to be done. Nick then teams up with fellow Guardian journalist Amelia Hill, who has a source within the Met's new hacking investigation. Meanwhile, a tip-off from Charlotte Harris leads Nick to wonder if hacking was far more egregious, and the information he discovers next has the potential to blow the hacking scandal wide open.

programme.title: Mr Bates vs the Post Office: The Impact
programme.desc: In January 2024, the drama series Mr Bates vs The Post Office brought the story of the faulty Horizon computer and the subpostmasters wrongfully accused of theft to a national audience.
